transcript.text: dryer drum wont turn but i can here it running, hotpiont. clothes just sit there

That sounds like the motor is running but the drive belt has slipped off or snapped, which is a common cause when the drum stays still while you hear the machine working. It could also be something jammed in the drum or a worn tension pulley, so let's rule out simple issues first. Please make sure the dryer is switched off and unplugged from the wall for safety. Then, with the drum empty, try turning it by hand to see if it spins freely or feels stiff and stuck. Let me know what resistance you feel when you turn it manually.
ok unplugged it, drum spins really easy by hand almost no resistance

Since the drum spins freely by hand but doesn't turn when running, it strongly suggests the drive belt has snapped or slipped off the motor pulley. To help you find the correct replacement part for your Hotpoint, could you please provide the model number? This is usually found on a sticker inside the door opening. If you can't reach that label right now, don't worry—we can wait until it's convenient.
[Panel: "To check a suitable replacement — Enter your model number below. Once we have the model I can check whether a suitable replacement is available. It's usually on a sticker inside the door or around the frame, or on the back of the appliance."]

the sticker is worn so i can only read the start its TVHM8 and the rest has rubbed off. also i heard a twang then a thud yesterday and theres a black rubbery strip at the bottom when i look through the filter slot with a torch

[Heading: Likely cause: drive belt]
The "twang" sound and seeing a black rubber strip confirm the drive belt has snapped, which explains why the motor runs but the drum doesn't turn. Since I can't find a confirmed match for your specific TVHM8 model number to give you the exact part code, it's best not to guess. You should check the manufacturer's official spares site or contact an engineer who can identify the correct belt for your machine. If you'd like, I can help you look up the full model number on the appliance itself so you can order the right part.
